entries.name: Citizen Experiential Capital
entries.statement: E_c = {Experience, Observation, Context, Practice, Failure, Constraint, Goal}

entries.name: Provisional Knowledge-like Capital
entries.statement: K*_0 = Compose(E_c, A_exchange | AccessibleEvidence)

entries.name: Institutionally Escalated Knowledge-like Capital
entries.statement: K*_I = Compose(K*_0, E_set, I_service | R, D_own, D_public)

entries.name: Institutional Escalation Need
entries.statement: E_inst = f(Risk, DiagnosticUncertainty, Irreversibility, SpecializedEvidenceNeed, ProfessionalAuthorityNeed, RegulatorySensitivity, PopulationExposure)

entries.name: Total Citizen Route Cost
entries.statement: C_total(r) = C_money(r) + lambda*C_time(r) + mu*C_cognitive(r) + nu*C_access(r) + xi*C_coordination(r) + rho*C_opportunity(r)

entries.name: Minimum-Cost Sufficient Route
entries.statement: r* = argmin_r C_total(r), subject to Safety(r)>=S_min, EvidenceAdequacy(r)>=E_needed, Rights(r)=PASS, DecisionUsability(r)=TRUE, AuthorityRequirements(r)=satisfied

entries.name: Citizen Action Readiness
entries.statement: ACTION_READY = TRUE iff ProblemStructured AND HardRisksCleared AND EvidenceSufficientForAction AND ResidualUncertaintyAcceptable AND ActionFeasibleForCitizen

entries.name: Next-Best Information Action
entries.statement: a* = argmax_a [ExpectedInformationGain(a)*DecisionRelevance(a)] / [Cost(a) + lambda*Time(a) + mu*RiskExposure(a) + epsilon]

entries.name: Field Risk Exposure
entries.statement: RiskExposure(a) = AssetAtRisk(a)*HarmSeverity(a)*Irreversibility(a)

entries.name: Counterfactual Difference-in-Differences Readout
entries.statement: DeltaY = (Y_T,post - Y_T,pre) - (Y_C,post - Y_C,pre)
entries.note: Use where a practical comparison is available; does not by itself establish universal causality.

entries.name: Transferability Heuristic
entries.statement: Transferability = f(MechanismStability, CrossSiteReplication, ImplementationSensitivity, ContextSimilarity, HumanDependence)

entries.name: Innovation Promotion Gate
entries.statement: INNOVATION_PROMOTE = TRUE iff PreInnovationDisposition=INNOVATION_CANDIDATE AND LocalResultConfidence>=required_level AND ExistingSolutionCheckCompleted AND NoveltyScopeSufficientForClaim AND TransferabilityStateAppropriateForIntendedClaim AND RightsSafetyConstraintsPass

entries.name: Knowledge-like Asset Map
entries.statement: K_MAP(K*) = {K_claim, K_knowhow, K_process, K_data, K_artifact, K_rights, K_relational, K_context, K_brand_trust, K_market}

entries.name: Knowledge Portability Vector
entries.statement: P_K = [C_k, 1-T_k, 1-X_k, 1-H_k, R_k, S_rights, 1-Rel_k]

entries.name: Knowledge Portability Heuristic
entries.statement: Portability_K = GeometricMean(P_K)

entries.name: Knowledge Utilization Route Value
entries.statement: RouteValue_U(r) = [KnowledgeRouteFit(r,K_MAP)*CreatorRoleFitSoft(r)*RecipientCapability(r)*ExpectedValueRealized(r)*MissionFit(r)*RightsPreservation(r)] / [TransferFriction(r)+GovernanceCost(r)+CapitalNeed(r)+Time(r)+StrategicRisk(r)+epsilon]

entries.name: Knowledge Utilization Route Selection
entries.statement: UtilizationRoute* = argmax_r RouteValue_U(r), subject to hard route gates G_U(r)=PASS

entries.name: Market Channel Conditional Value
entries.statement: ChannelValue(c|r) = [Reach(c,r)*CounterpartyQuality(c,r)*TransactionProbability(c,r)] / [SearchCost(c,r)+Time(c,r)+DisclosureRisk(c,r)+epsilon]

entries.name: Business-0 Formation Predicate
entries.statement: B0_F = TRUE iff AccountableOwner AND MinimumViableTeamAdequate AND RightsGate=PASS AND DemandRouteExists AND LegalRouteReady AND TransactionDesignDefined AND MilestoneRunwayToFirstDelivery>=0 AND InnovationVentureFitAcceptable

entries.name: First Economic Cycle Closure Predicate
entries.statement: B0_C = TRUE iff B0_F AND DemandIndependence>=required_rung AND WorldBoundCommitment AND FirstDeliveryCompleted AND ValueExchangeOccurred AND TrueCostRecorded AND LearningLoopActive

entries.name: True Resource Cost
entries.statement: TrueCost = CashCost + ImputedFounderLabor + InKindResourceCost + GrantSupportedCost + ComplianceAmortization + SharedInfrastructureCost

entries.name: Milestone Runway
entries.statement: MilestoneRunway = AvailableCapital - CapitalToNextGate

entries.name: Business Regime Transition
entries.statement: RegimeTransition_(t->t+1) = 1[R_(t+1) != R_t]

entries.name: Sustainable Operating Capacity
entries.statement: C_sustainable = min(C_people, C_asset, C_supplier, C_capital, C_space, C_approval, C_service, C_logistics)

entries.name: Execution Debt
entries.statement: D_exec = max(0, CommittedDemand - C_sustainable)

entries.name: Incremental Growth Value
entries.statement: DeltaV_growth = DeltaRevenue - DeltaOperatingCost - DeltaFormalizationCost - DeltaCapitalCost - DeltaMaintenanceCost - DeltaExternalityCost - DeltaDependencyRisk - DeltaFailureReserve

entries.name: Institution Utility
entries.statement: InstitutionUtility(i|s) = [CapabilityFit(i,s)*Accessibility(i,s)*ExpectedDecisionGain(i,s)*Timeliness(i,s)] / [MoneyCost(i,s)+TimeCost(i,s)+AccessBurden(i,s)+CoordinationCost(i,s)+epsilon]

entries.name: Problem Representation Triplet
entries.statement: P_C=CitizenProblem; P_S=AIStructuredProblem; P_D=DisciplinaryProblem

entries.name: Meaning Preservation State
entries.statement: MeaningPreserved(P_next,P_C) in {PASS,HOLD_UNKNOWN,FAIL}

entries.name: Valid Handoff Predicate
entries.statement: HANDOFF_VALID = TRUE iff MeaningPreserved=PASS AND RequestedCapabilityNamed AND DecisionOwnerNamed AND ConsentPass AND DataUseScopeKnown AND ReturnRequired AND ResponseTimeFit AND FallbackRouteKnown

entries.name: Response-Time Fit
entries.statement: TimeFit(i) = DecisionWindow - ExpectedResponseTime_i

entries.name: Return-to-Citizen Gate
entries.statement: RETURN_GATE = PASS iff UsableResultReturned AND KnownUnknownsStated AND NextActionStated AND RelevantDataReturned AND CitizenCorrectionPossible AND UnresolvedRiskAndRightsDisclosed

entries.name: Bridge Integrity Bottleneck
entries.statement: BridgeIntegrity = min(MeaningLegibility, Access, IncentiveAlignment, EffectiveCoordinationAuthority, Continuity, RightsClarity, ResponseTimeFit)

entries.name: Cross-Actor Route Utility
entries.statement: CrossActorUtility(r) = [CapabilityFit(r)*BridgeIntegrity(r)*ExpectedDecisionGain(r)*ReturnProbability(r)] / [MoneyCost(r)+TimeCost(r)+CoordinationCost(r)+RightsRisk(r)+epsilon]

entries.name: Citizen Closure Predicate
entries.statement: CITIZEN_CLOSURE = TRUE iff ReturnGate=PASS AND UsableResultReachesDecisionOwner AND OriginalCitizenGoal in {resolved, improved, safely_held, explicitly_rescoped_with_consent}

entries.name: Citizen Success
entries.statement: CitizenSuccess = SafeUsefulResolution + TraceableLearning
entries.note: Innovation is optional; '+' is conceptual composition, not an asserted cardinal metric.
